text:
Ava (AE): Quick sync — Bluecrest wants a 4-week trial to validate invoice extraction + redaction. Need a sandbox with sample data (S3), redaction pipeline, evals, and success criteria by EOD Thu. Can SE scope? cc Priya
Priya (SE): On it. Quick Qs: how many distinct customers/tenants? expected daily traffic? are PII fields known? any compliance reqs (PCI/HIPAA)?
Ava (AE): Single-tenant POC for now. ~25k invoice rows, 5k unique vendors. PII: names, bank acct masked, SSNs in subset. HIPAA no, but SOC2 + DPA needed. Timeline: ingest + redaction in week 1, evals week 2-3, wrap week 4.
Priya (SE): Got it. Proposed success criteria:
- Automated redaction: precision >= 95% on PII fields
- Extraction accuracy: F1 >= 0.85 on key-value pairs (date, total, vendor)
- Latency: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 350ms for gen calls
- Throughput: 12 req/s sustained
- No sensitive data stored unencrypted in hosted logs
Priya (SE): Need sample prompts + 200 labeled invoices for evals. Can we get a sanitized sample set? Also what connectivity — customer S3 or we host a sandbox S3?
Ava (AE): Bluecrest can upload to our pre-signed S3 bucket, they want to retain ownership. They prefer VPC endpoint (private) for transfer and will keep original docs encrypted + KMS. They've signed the DPA draft (I forwarded).
Sam (Eng): For latency/throughput those numbers work on hosted but may need a medium dedicated pool for sustained 12 req/s with low p95. Otherwise add burst capacity or caching. If they insist on private infra, lead time ~2w to provision.
Priya (SE): Two options to present:
1) Hosted sandbox (fast): we provide pre-signed bucket + VPC endpoint, streaming API, ephemeral logs. Cost: est $2.8k for the workload over 4 weeks.
2) Dedicated trial (higher SLA): reserved pool, +$1.2k pro-rated for the month.
Jonas (Solutions): Also prepare answers for security questionnaire items:
- KMS integration: yes (customer keys supported)
- Data residency: EU or US regions possible
- Access logs: available, retention options
- Pen tests: we provide summary report
Elena (CS): Success criteria — include business KPIs: speed of manual review reduced by 80% and curation time < 2 min per invoice for exceptions.
Ava (AE): Bluecrest also asked about prompt/eval transparency — they want eval scripts and baseline run. Can we share eval harness and seed prompts?
Priya (SE): Yes, we'll share the harness repo link and a short runbook. Example run command:
```
python eval/run_invoice_eval.py --data s3://redwood-trial-bluecrest/sample --model redwood-llm-optimized --threshold 0.85
```
Priya (SE): Need an example mapping for redaction fields (json schema). Also request for sample labeled set by Wed.
Ava (AE): I'll nudge them. Also they asked for pricing: what's the POC pricing model and post-POC commercial path?
Jonas (Solutions): POC pricing: flat $3k for the 4-week trial (covers support, up to 20h SE/Eng). If they go to production, options:
- Hosted pay-as-you-go (per-token + embedding)
- Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit)
We'll share a pricing sheet and discount guidance.
Sam (Eng): One engineering blocker: customer requires HSM-backed KMS for key wrapping. We support Cloud KMS customer-managed keys; HSM on-prem would need legal + infra review and ~1-2w. Flagging now.
Ava (AE): Call out blockers so we can flag to customer.
Priya (SE): Action items:
- Priya: draft eval matrix + harness link (ETA: tomorrow noon)
- Sam: confirm feasibility for HSM/KMS + estimate provisioning time (ETA: EOD today)
- Jonas: draft POC pricing + post-POC options (ETA: tomorrow)
- Elena: success criteria mapped to business KPIs (ETA: tomorrow)
- Ava: get sanitized sample + DPA confirmation from customer (ETA: Wed)
deploy-bot: Sandbox S3 bucket redwood-trial-bluecrest provisioned (arn:aws:s3:::redwood-trial-bluecrest). Pre-signed upload URL expires in 7d.
Ava (AE): Perfect. Priya, once you have the eval matrix I'll review and then we'll share with Bluecrest. Also add a checklist for redaction QA.
Priya (SE): Will do. Quick note: ask customer to include screenshots of edge-case invoices (handwritten lines) if available.
Ava (AE): Noted. Thanks team :tada:
